crates.name: simbiguity
crates.description: An open source simulation engine by The Ambiguity Project: simulation, animation and 3D rendering for education.

crates.name: simbiguity-anim
crates.description: Zero-dependency, no_std animation math for simbiguity: easing curves, tweens, keyframe tracks, timelines and springs. No renderer; usable anywhere.

crates.name: simbiguity-circuits
crates.description: A DC circuit engine for education: batteries, resistors, bulbs, switches and wires, solved by Modified Nodal Analysis, with diagnostics a learner can understand.

crates.name: simbiguity-circuits-view
crates.description: A 3D view of a simbiguity circuit: component models, wire tubes, current particles and bulb glow, all driven by the solved circuit.

crates.name: simbiguity-circuits-wasm
crates.description: A hand-written C-ABI / WebAssembly bridge for simbiguity-circuits: opaque handles, status codes and shared linear memory, no wasm-bindgen.

crates.name: simbiguity-core
crates.description: Shared contracts for simbiguity engines: the Simulation trait, snapshots, a fixed-timestep clock, a seeded RNG and a lockstep runner.

crates.name: simbiguity-math
crates.description: Zero-dependency, no_std math for simbiguity: vectors, quaternions, matrices, a dense linear solver and deterministic float functions.

crates.name: simbiguity-render
crates.description: Zero-dependency, no_std, renderer-agnostic 3D for simbiguity: meshes, materials, lights, an orbit camera and picking rays, compiled into a flat draw-command buffer any backend can replay.

crates.name: simbiguity-render-wasm
crates.description: A hand-written C-ABI / WebAssembly bridge for simbiguity's 3D views: build a view, step its animation, encode a frame's draw commands, pick under the cursor. No wasm-bindgen.

capabilities.name: Easing curves and tweens
capabilities.description: Classic easing curves that start at exactly 0 and end at exactly 1, and tweens that blend any value between two endpoints.

capabilities.name: Springs
capabilities.description: Damped springs in every regime that settle within their predicted time; the 3D bulb's glow rides on one.

capabilities.name: Keyframe tracks and timelines
capabilities.description: Keyframe tracks that hold before the first key and after the last, and timelines that sequence clips with exact seeking.

capabilities.name: Ohm's law, series and parallel
capabilities.description: Current, voltage and power through resistors in series and in parallel, matching the hand calculation to nine decimal places.

capabilities.name: Real batteries and bridge circuits
capabilities.description: Internal resistance that sags the terminal voltage, balanced and unbalanced Wheatstone bridges, and batteries of different EMF fighting in parallel.

capabilities.name: Switches and bulb brightness
capabilities.description: A switch opens and closes the loop, and a bulb's brightness follows the power it dissipates relative to its rating.

capabilities.name: Diagnostics a learner can understand
capabilities.description: Short circuits, impossible values and floating parts are reported in plain language instead of producing a wrong number.

capabilities.name: Bulbs that blow
capabilities.description: Overdrive a bulb and its filament burns out, opening the circuit, and it stays blown until it is replaced. In series, the most overloaded bulb goes first.

capabilities.name: Modified Nodal Analysis solver
capabilities.description: Netlists are built from components and wires, merged into nodes and solved as one linear system per connected island.

capabilities.name: Deterministic, snapshot-able simulation
capabilities.description: The same circuit always solves to the same bits, and a snapshot restores a running simulation exactly.

capabilities.name: Capacitors and RC charging
capabilities.description: A capacitor charges through a resistor along the textbook exponential curve, reaching 63% of the supply after one time constant.

capabilities.name: Charge flowing as fast as the current
capabilities.description: Particles move along the wires at a speed proportional to the solved current, and sit still when the loop is open.

capabilities.name: A bulb that warms up and cools down
capabilities.description: Glow follows brightness through a spring, so a bulb fades in when the switch closes and burns out visibly when overdriven.

capabilities.name: A board you can orbit and click
capabilities.description: An orbit camera frames the board from a three-quarter view, and a click picks the switch to flip it.

capabilities.name: Deterministic animation
capabilities.description: Seeking to a time or advancing in fixed steps always produces the same frame, so captures and replays are exact.

capabilities.name: The circuits engine in the browser
capabilities.description: A hand-written WebAssembly bridge: opaque handles, status codes and shared memory, with every export rejecting a bad handle instead of crashing.

capabilities.name: A fixed-timestep clock
capabilities.description: Real frame times are banked into exact fixed steps with no drift, so every engine advances the same way on every machine.

capabilities.name: A seeded, reproducible RNG
capabilities.description: PCG32, pinned bit for bit to the reference sequence, so a seeded run is identical across platforms.

capabilities.name: Snapshots and replay
capabilities.description: Restoring a snapshot and replaying the same inputs reproduces a simulation exactly.

capabilities.name: Deterministic float functions
capabilities.description: Hand-written float functions with no libm, giving the same bits on every platform, signed zeros and infinities included.

capabilities.name: Vectors, matrices and quaternions
capabilities.description: The 3D math every engine shares: componentwise vectors, column-major matrices and right-hand-rule quaternions.

capabilities.name: A dense linear solver
capabilities.description: Gaussian elimination with partial pivoting that solves well-posed systems exactly and reports singular ones instead of guessing.

capabilities.name: Meshes, paths and an orbit camera
capabilities.description: Procedural meshes with unit normals, polylines you can walk at a distance, and an orbit camera that projects the target to the centre of the view.

capabilities.name: Picking with rays
capabilities.description: A click becomes a ray into the scene, and the nearest visible, tagged object along it is the one you hit.

capabilities.name: Renderer-agnostic draw commands
capabilities.description: Each frame is sorted into opaque and back-to-front glass passes and encoded as a compact command buffer that survives a decode round trip unchanged.

capabilities.name: 3D views in the browser
capabilities.description: A hand-written WebAssembly bridge that builds a 3D view, steps its animation and hands each frame's draw commands to a from-scratch WebGL2 renderer.

tests.name: seeding_and_streams_are_reproducible
tests.description: Same seed gives the same sequence; different seeds or streams differ; clones continue identically (snapshot safety).

tests.name: restore_then_replay_is_bit_identical
tests.description: Restoring a snapshot and replaying the same inputs reproduces the exact same state bit for bit, RNG included.

tests.name: seconds_arithmetic
tests.description: Seconds arithmetic and from_hz behave like plain f64 durations.

tests.name: range_u32_is_unbiased_and_covers_span
tests.description: range_u32 must reach every value with no visible bias, including a span that does not divide 2^32.

tests.name: floats_and_ranges_stay_in_bounds
tests.description: Floats stay in [0, 1) and ranges stay half-open; empty ranges return lo.

tests.name: normal_has_unit_moments
tests.description: Normals have mean ≈ 0 and variance ≈ 1; normal_with shifts and scales.

tests.name: abs_and_copysign_handle_sign_bit_exactly
tests.description: abs and copysign only touch the sign bit, so they must preserve signed zero, infinities and the magnitude exactly.

tests.name: atan2_quadrants_and_zeros
tests.description: atan2 must match the platform in every quadrant and follow IEEE for signed zeros on the axes.

tests.name: atan_reduce_flips_and_shrinks
tests.description: Reduction must flip above 1 and shrink u below tan(π/16) so the series converges.

tests.name: exp_taylor_is_accurate_on_reduced_interval
tests.description: The Taylor kernel must be exact at zero and accurate at the edges of its reduced interval.

tests.name: exp_thresholds_and_extremes
tests.description: The overflow and underflow thresholds and the split scale path just inside them must give inf, zero, and finite gradual-underflow values.

tests.name: exp_matches_platform_within_two_ulp
tests.description: exp must be within 2 ulp of the platform across its useful range.

tests.name: next_down_steps_toward_negative_infinity
tests.description: next_down must step toward −∞ for positive, negative and zero inputs alike, since a raw bits−1 steps the wrong way for negatives.

tests.name: odd_series_signs_and_values
tests.description: The odd-denominator series must start at 1, follow the requested sign pattern, and converge to atan/atanh identities for small z.

tests.name: reduce_quadrant_lands_in_the_central_interval
tests.description: Quadrant reduction must leave a remainder within about π/4 and pick the quadrant that sin_cos's sign table expects.

tests.name: round_down_if_closer_picks_the_nearer_neighbour
tests.description: The 1-ulp correction steps down only when the lower neighbour's square is strictly closer, and otherwise leaves the guess alone.

tests.name: scale_pow2_splits_large_shifts
tests.description: The power-of-two scaler must stay exact past the normal exponent range by splitting the shift, which exp and the subnormal paths need.

tests.name: ln_matches_platform_and_special_cases
tests.description: ln must be within 2 ulp of the platform and handle 0, negatives, infinity and subnormals.

tests.name: split_mantissa_reconstructs_input
tests.description: The mantissa split must reconstruct x and keep m in [√½, √2].

tests.name: sqrt_matches_platform_within_one_ulp
tests.description: sqrt must be within 1 ulp of the correctly rounded platform result across many magnitudes, and exact on perfect squares.

tests.name: sin_cos_match_platform
tests.description: sin and cos must stay within 2e-16 absolute of the platform across all four quadrants and moderately large angles.

tests.name: sqrt_newton_converges_to_within_one_ulp
tests.description: The Newton stage alone must already land within one ulp, so the correction only ever has a single neighbour to consider.

tests.name: sqrt_special_and_subnormal_inputs
tests.description: Subnormals take a scaled detour; NaN, negatives, zero and infinity are special-cased and must come back as IEEE prescribes.

tests.name: atan_matches_platform_within_four_ulp
tests.description: atan must hit the known values exactly enough and stay within 4 ulp of the platform on both sides of the |x| = 1 reciprocal switch.

tests.name: tan_matches_platform_away_from_poles
tests.description: tan is sin/cos, so it must agree with the platform away from poles.

tests.name: unit_complement_values
tests.description: The unit complement is √(1−x²), exact at the ends and the middle.

tests.name: trunc_floor_round_are_exact
tests.description: trunc, floor and round are the building blocks of every range reduction; they must be exact, including negatives and halfway cases.

tests.name: back_substitute_solves_upper_factor
tests.description: Back substitution solves the upper factor from the bottom up.

tests.name: check_rhs_len_accepts_and_rejects
tests.description: The length check passes on a match and reports both sizes otherwise.

tests.name: choose_pivot_picks_largest_magnitude_at_or_below_k
tests.description: The pivot search must look only at or below row k, compare magnitudes, and keep the earliest row on ties.

tests.name: eliminate_below_stores_multipliers_and_updates_rows
tests.description: Elimination must zero the column below the pivot (storing the multipliers there) and update the trailing block.

tests.name: forward_substitute_applies_perm_and_lower_factor
tests.description: Forward substitution permutes b and applies the unit-lower factor.

tests.name: lu_resolves_for_several_rhs
tests.description: A factored matrix must be reusable for several right-hand sides.

tests.name: acos_asin_match_platform_and_domain
tests.description: acos and asin must agree with the platform on [-1, 1] and reject out-of-domain inputs.

tests.name: lu_solve_empty_system
tests.description: The empty system has the empty solution.

tests.name: lu_solve_pivots_past_a_zero_leading_entry
tests.description: A zero in the leading position must be pivoted around rather than reported as singular.

tests.name: lu_solve_reports_each_error_variant
tests.description: Singular, non-square and wrongly sized systems must report the specific error variant, not panic.

tests.name: lu_solve_solves_a_known_system
tests.description: A well-posed 3×3 system must solve to its known answer, and the result must reproduce b when multiplied back.

tests.name: lu_solve_one_by_one_system
tests.description: A 1×1 system is plain division.

tests.name: max_abs_entry_ignores_sign
tests.description: The largest magnitude must ignore sign and be 0 for empty/zero input.

tests.name: solve_error_display_messages
tests.description: Error messages must name the problem in plain words.

tests.name: dense_matrix_basics
tests.description: Dense constructors, row access, row swaps and mat-vec products.

tests.name: identity_default_and_get_layout
tests.description: The identity is the default and leaves points unchanged; element access follows column-major layout.

tests.name: inverse_undoes_and_rejects_singular
tests.description: The inverse must undo a general transform and refuse singular input.

tests.name: mul_order_and_transpose
tests.description: Composition applies the right operand first, and transpose swaps rows and columns.

tests.name: offset_maps_row_major_positions
tests.description: The offset helper maps row-major positions and IndexMut writes there.

tests.name: perspective_and_look_at
tests.description: Perspective puts the near and far planes at clip depth −1 and +1 and shrinks distant points; look_at maps the eye to the origin and the target onto −Z, returning identity for degenerate input.

tests.name: offset_rejects_column_overflow
tests.description: A column past the end must panic instead of reading the next row.

tests.name: rotation_matches_quaternion
tests.description: The rotation matrix must agree with rotating by the quaternion.

tests.name: row_dot_reads_column_major_rows
tests.description: The row helper must dot the right column-major entries and include the translation column only in proportion to w.

tests.name: translation_and_scale_on_points_and_vectors
tests.description: Translation moves points but not directions; scale stretches both.

tests.name: from_axis_angle_rotates_by_right_hand_rule
tests.description: Axis-angle builds unit quaternions that rotate by the right-hand rule; a zero axis gives the identity.

tests.name: mul_composes_and_conjugate_inverts
tests.description: Multiplication composes right-first and the conjugate undoes a rotation.

tests.name: neg_is_same_rotation
tests.description: Negation flips every component and is the same rotation.

tests.name: normalize_unit_and_zero
tests.description: Normalize restores unit length and maps zero to the identity.

tests.name: rotate_preserves_length
tests.description: Rotating by a unit quaternion never changes a vector's length.

tests.name: slerp_endpoints_midpoint_and_short_arc
tests.description: Slerp hits both ends, moves at constant angle, and takes the short arc even when given the negated target.

tests.name: slerp_weights_lerp_fallback_and_sine_ratio
tests.description: The weights sum to the lerp fallback near d = 1 and follow the sin-ratio formula otherwise; at θ = π/2 the midpoint weights are √½.

tests.name: arithmetic_is_componentwise
tests.description: The macro-generated operators must act componentwise on both types.

tests.name: cross_and_perp_dot_right_hand_rule
tests.description: Cross products follow the right-hand rule; perp_dot is its 2D z part.

tests.name: cross_is_perpendicular_to_both_inputs
tests.description: The cross product is perpendicular to both inputs, as the plan's identity requires.

tests.name: dot_length_distance_lerp
tests.description: Dot, length, distance and lerp follow their textbook definitions.

tests.name: normalize_unit_or_none
tests.description: Normalize gives unit vectors and refuses the zero vector.

tests.name: eye_sits_on_the_orbit_sphere
tests.description: With zero yaw and pitch the eye sits on +Z at the orbit distance.

tests.name: orbit_clamps_pitch
tests.description: Orbiting clamps the pitch to its limits.

tests.name: points_behind_the_camera_do_not_project
tests.description: Points behind the camera do not project.

tests.name: project_lands_known_points_on_known_pixels
tests.description: The target projects to the viewport centre, and a point to its right lands right of centre.

tests.name: ray_inverts_project
tests.description: A ray through a projected pixel passes back through the point.

tests.name: view_projection_composes
tests.description: The view-projection is the projection times the view.

tests.name: zoom_scales_within_limits
tests.description: Zoom scales distance within limits and ignores nonsense factors.

tests.name: clear_keeps_only_the_header
tests.description: clear drops every command but keeps the header, and Default equals new.

tests.name: floats_are_stored_as_bits
tests.description: f32 payloads are stored as their bit patterns.

tests.name: headers_pack_opcode_and_length
tests.description: Each header packs the opcode in the low byte and the payload word count above it.

tests.name: bad_headers_are_rejected
tests.description: A short buffer, wrong magic or unknown version is rejected.

tests.name: depth_flags_treat_nonzero_as_true
tests.description: Any nonzero depth word means true.

tests.name: every_command_round_trips
tests.description: Every command survives an encode and decode round trip unchanged.

tests.name: header_is_magic_then_version
tests.description: The header is the magic word then the version, and an empty buffer decodes to nothing.

tests.name: out_of_range_enum_values_are_rejected
tests.description: Out-of-range program, uniform and blend values are rejected.

tests.name: truncated_payload_is_rejected
tests.description: A payload that runs past the end of the buffer is truncated.

tests.name: unknown_opcode_is_rejected
tests.description: An opcode this version does not define is an error naming the word.

tests.name: wrong_payload_length_is_rejected
tests.description: A payload length that does not fit the opcode is an error.

tests.name: glass_is_sorted_back_to_front
tests.description: Glass is drawn back to front: the far box before the near one.

tests.name: frame_brackets_its_passes
tests.description: A frame starts with viewport, clear and opaque state, ends restoring it, and draws every visible lit node.

tests.name: instances_draw_in_one_call
tests.description: Instanced particles draw once with every offset; an empty set draws nothing and skips the additive pass.

tests.name: opaque_nodes_group_by_program
tests.description: Opaque nodes are grouped by program, unlit before lit, and hidden nodes are left out.

tests.name: programs_are_bound_only_on_change
tests.description: Each program is bound once per pass, not once per node.

tests.name: unlit_glows_are_skipped
tests.description: Only lit halos are drawn.

tests.name: zero_viewport_is_clamped
tests.description: A zero-size viewport is drawn as one pixel rather than dividing by zero.

tests.name: degenerate_tubes_are_empty
tests.description: A tube needs two distinct points; duplicates are dropped and too few points give an empty mesh.

tests.name: empty_mesh_bounds_are_a_point
tests.description: An empty mesh has a point box at the origin.

tests.name: bounds_match_the_requested_size
tests.description: Primitives are centred on the origin with the size asked for.

tests.name: counts_match_the_resolution
tests.description: Vertex and triangle counts follow from the primitive's resolution.

tests.name: resolutions_have_a_floor
tests.description: Low resolutions are raised to the minimum that still makes a solid.

tests.name: tube_follows_its_path
tests.description: Every ring of a tube stays its radius away from the path it follows.

tests.name: degenerate_paths
tests.description: An empty path gives the origin, and zero-length segments are skipped.

tests.name: length_sums_segments
tests.description: The length of a polyline is the sum of its segments.

tests.name: normals_are_unit_and_indices_in_range
tests.description: Every vertex normal is unit length and every index is in range.

tests.name: point_along_walks_segments
tests.description: Walking a distance lands on the right segment at the right place.

tests.name: boxes_grow_by_points
tests.description: Empty grows to a point, then to a box holding every point.

tests.name: expanded_adds_margin
tests.description: Expanding adds a margin on every side.

tests.name: point_along_clamps_to_ends
tests.description: Distances before the start or past the end clamp to the ends.

tests.name: ray_hits_the_near_face
tests.description: A ray aimed at a box enters it at the near face.

tests.name: triangles_wind_counter_clockwise_from_outside
tests.description: Every non-degenerate triangle is wound counter-clockwise seen from outside.

tests.name: ray_misses
tests.description: A ray that passes beside or points away from the box misses.

tests.name: ray_from_inside_hits_at_zero
tests.description: A ray starting inside the box hits at distance zero.

tests.name: transformed_bounds_the_moved_box
tests.description: A transformed box bounds every transformed corner.

tests.name: a_miss_is_none
tests.description: A ray that misses everything picks nothing.

tests.name: default_light_is_unit_and_overhead
tests.description: The default light points up and toward the viewer, at unit length.

tests.name: hidden_and_untagged_nodes_are_not_picked
tests.description: Hidden or untagged nodes are skipped.

tests.name: ids_and_world_bounds
tests.description: Ids index meshes and nodes in insertion order; world bounds follow the transform.

tests.name: materials_know_when_they_blend
tests.description: The material constructors set shading, and blending is needed for translucency and glow only.

tests.name: pick_returns_the_nearest_hit
tests.description: The nearest pickable node along the ray wins.

tests.name: fields_land_in_their_slots
tests.description: Every field lands in its documented slot, booleans as one or zero.

tests.name: flags_flip
tests.description: An open, blown, unsolved circuit packs its flags the other way round.

tests.name: camera_exports_use_degrees_and_clamp
tests.description: The camera exports work in degrees and clamp to the camera's limits.

tests.name: encode_writes_a_decodable_frame
tests.description: An encoded frame is a valid command buffer that sets the requested viewport.

tests.name: bad_handles_are_rejected
tests.description: A freed or never-issued handle is an error with a readable message.

tests.name: inputs_reach_the_view
tests.description: Toggle reports the new switch state and volts, replace and seek reach the view.

tests.name: new_view_reads_back_its_state
tests.description: A new view hands out a nonzero handle and reads back the state it was built with.

tests.name: mesh_exports_cover_every_mesh
tests.description: Mesh exports describe every mesh, and an index past the end is an error.

tests.name: pick_hits_the_switch_and_misses_the_sky
tests.description: Picking at the pixel the switch base projects to hits the switch; a corner of the sky hits nothing.
